name: e2-memory-breakdown-febd2bc1-20261016
description: Isolated public API stages, one process and one call per input/stage; main-DP activity counters plus lifetime peak RSS. Baseline inside changes retention as well as omitting the outer guide.

analysis.scope: GNU time whole-process wall time and peak RSS for each isolated API call; includes preparation, result assembly and process startup. No full-value export.
analysis.input_identity: All seven current input byte hashes checked against the reference array plan on 2026-10-16; identical S/G.
analysis.counter_scope: BeamWorkStats covers main forward only, excluding scaffold-only prepass and outer pilot/guide. StructuralProfileResult exposes no BeamWorkStats.
analysis.memory_limit_kind: Per-process RLIMIT_AS address-space cap, 8192 MiB; not an RSS limit.
analysis.interpretation: Peak RSS values are not additive. Baseline changes retained states; it does not isolate guide allocation. Family counters are activity counts, not allocated bytes.

rerun.memory_basis: Explicit per-process RLIMIT_AS cap; allocation feasibility is not a measured RSS prediction.

rna_4_8kb.basis: 2026-10-16 E2 note, d21618c5 cpu_40 b=h=d=100 outer: max LinearCParty wall by tier 350.41/937.37/1293.19 s, peak RSS up to 35.7734 GiB. Each stage is budgeted as a full CLI with rounded tier maximum plus 0.001*n seconds; safety factor 2 across five processes. Baseline retention can differ, so this is an envelope, not a calibrated stage prediction. Memory envelope 40960 MiB exceeds historical peak and stays below the 48 GiB address-space cap.
